evals.prompt: 我们分析完了，核心问题是游戏缺少反馈循环——玩家的行为不影响世界状态，所以叙事和机制是脱节的。方向是：需要一个机制让玩家的订单完成和物品处理产生世界层面的后果。给我几个具体方案。
evals.expected_output: 3-5 distinct proposals each with 想法/规则变更/分析, grounded in actual game systems

assertions.description: Generates 3-5 distinct proposals
Each proposal has all required sections (想法/规则变更/分析)
Rule changes specify actual modifications (not abstract concepts)
Proposals reference actual game systems accurately
Proposals span different ambition levels
Each proposal's 想法 section explicitly names the problem (feedback loop) and explains the causal chain of how it solves it — not just describes a mechanic
Proposals use plain descriptive language, not invented compound nouns or coined terms (e.g. no '回声队列', '池子生态', '世界状态板' style naming)
When proposals add new systems or state, they justify why that complexity is necessary. Simpler proposals exist alongside complex ones.
Analysis section addresses whether the proposal risks hurting existing fun (e.g. slowing pace, restricting choices) with explicit tradeoff reasoning

evals.prompt: 我想给紧急订单系统加点东西，让它不只是'限时交货'这么简单。现在紧急订单和普通订单体验差别不大，就是多了个时间压力。我想让它感觉上更独特、更有存在感。有什么方案？
evals.expected_output: 3-5 proposals with specific rule changes for emergency orders

assertions.description: Generates 3-5 distinct proposals
Each proposal has all required sections (想法/规则变更/分析)
Rule changes specify actual modifications to emergency order rules
Proposals reference actual emergency order mechanics accurately
Proposals span different ambition levels
Each proposal's 想法 explains HOW it makes emergency orders feel more unique/distinct from regular orders — not just describes a rule change
Proposals use plain descriptive language, not invented compound nouns or fancy coined mechanic names
Proposals that add new systems justify why the added complexity is needed to differentiate emergency orders
Analysis addresses whether changes risk making emergency orders frustrating rather than exciting, with explicit reasoning

evals.prompt: 三个池子现在感觉都差不多，玩家抽的时候选择感不够强。我想让每个池子更有个性。
evals.expected_output: 3-5 proposals with specific rule changes for pool differentiation

assertions.description: Generates 3-5 distinct proposals
Each proposal has all required sections (想法/规则变更/分析)
Rule changes specify actual modifications to pool mechanics
Proposals reference actual pool mechanics accurately
Proposals span different ambition levels
Each proposal's 想法 explains HOW it creates stronger differentiation between pools and why that leads to meaningful choice
Proposals describe mechanics in ordinary language, not coined compound terms
Proposals don't pile on unnecessary new systems; when complexity is added, it's justified as necessary for differentiation
Analysis addresses whether pool differentiation risks making any pool feel bad to draw from or reducing the fun of the current draw experience
